decisions.reason: Exact locations and values favor precise, economical evidence retrieval.
Dependable implementation and integration suit a pragmatic worker.
Editorial emphasis and restrained voice reward good taste and clear expression despite premium cost.
Executing defined commands and recording results needs economical, direct operation.
Interacting failure modes and independent proof demand sustained, tenacious reasoning.
Conceptual coherence and growing boundaries favor broad perspective and discerning design judgment.
A defined script and exact mapping favor efficient execution with straightforward checks.
Known-cause changes across modules require dependable integration and validation.
Version-specific documented facts and citations favor faithful evidence retrieval.
Reframing ambiguous needs benefits from broad perspective without requiring prolonged investigation.
A complete occurrence list and supplied check make economical mechanical execution sufficient.
Migration and normal compatibility work suit persistent, pragmatic implementation.
Contradictory evidence and interacting mechanisms justify costly, sustained independent causal investigation.
Sensitive, unconstrained wording benefits from discerning taste and precise expression.
Established patterns across components and tests call for dependable implementation.
Failed approaches and subtle adversarial reasoning warrant the strongest sustained independent thought.
